Overview

Benin City is a city in Edo with a population of 1,782,000. A historic city known for its ancient Benin Kingdom bronzes and rich cultural heritage in southern Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
